capabilities: generate a Canvas file from a folder's markdown files
arrange note cards in a grid with configurable width, height, and spacing
watch the folder and update the latest Canvas on changes
narrow canvas nodes to content under a chosen heading
control canvas filename pattern and creation behavior in settings
extras: The demo section exists but its image content is not described in the text; only direct first-level files of a folder are included, nested folders are ignored.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas must be built manually; there is no built-in way to turn a folder's notes into a Canvas view automatically.
summary: Plugin that generates a Canvas file laying out the Markdown files of a chosen folder as cards in a configurable grid.
